test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Quant (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: 20 kg of rice costing ₹80 per kg is mixed with y kg of rice costing ₹100 per kg. If the cost of this mixed rice is ₹84 per kg, what is the value of y?
solution:
**Given:**

The 20 kg of rice costing = Rs. 80 per kg

The y kg of rice costing = Rs. 100 per kg

The cost of mixed rice = Rs. 84 per kg

**Formula used:**

Average cost price = {Q₁times P₁+Q₂times P₂over Q₁+Q₂} Where, Q​₁ and Q₂ = Quantity and P₁ and P₂ = Price of two types of materials

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ 84 = {20times 80+100 times yover 20 + y}

⇒ 1680 + 84y = 1600 + 100y

⇒ 1680 - 1600 = 100y - 84y

⇒ 80 = 16y

⇒ y = 5

**∴ The required result will be 5.**
